text_en: Thus said the Lord : Go and buy a potter’s earthenware jug. Take with you some of the elders of the people and some of the senior priests,
text_cn: 上主这样对耶肋米亚说：“你去向陶工买一个瓦瓶，然后带些民间长老和司祭首长，

text_en: and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom at the entry of the Potsherd Gate, and proclaim there the words that I tell you.
text_cn: 到陶业门进口处的本希农山谷去，在那里宣布我要对你说的话。

text_en: You shall say: Hear the word of the Lord , O kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I am going to bring such disaster upon this place that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.
text_cn: 你要说：犹大王和耶路撒冷的居民！请聆听上主的话。万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：看，我必给这地方招来灾祸，凡听见的，必要耳鸣，

text_en: Because the people have forsaken me, and have profaned this place by making offerings in it to other gods whom neither they nor their ancestors nor the kings of Judah have known, and because they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent,
text_cn: 因为他们离弃了我，使这地成了异地，在这里向他们和他们的祖先并犹大王都不认识的外邦神祇献香，使这地充满无辜的血，

text_en: and gone on building the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire as burnt offerings to Baal, which I did not command or decree, nor did it enter my mind;
text_cn: 给巴耳建立了高丘，向巴耳火焚自己的儿子作全燔祭：这都是我从没有吩咐，没有说过，没有想到的事。

text_en: therefore the days are surely coming, says the Lord , when this place shall no more be called Topheth, or the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of Slaughter.
text_cn: 因此，看，时日将到──上主的断语──这地方不再叫做托斐（fěi）特或本希农山谷，却要叫做‘屠杀谷’。

text_en: And in this place I will make void the plans of Judah and Jerusalem, and will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies for food to the birds of the air and to the wild animals of the earth.
text_cn: 在这地方，我必使犹大和耶路撒冷的计划落空，使他们在敌人面前丧身刀下，死在谋图他们性命者的手中，将他们的尸首丢弃给天空的飞鸟，和地上的走兽作食物。

text_en: And I will make this city a horror, a thing to be hissed at; everyone who passes by it will be horrified and will hiss because of all its disasters.
text_cn: 我必使这城成为惊愕的缘因和讥诮(qiào)的目标；使凡从这里经过的人，没有不因她所受的一切打击，而感到惊异嗟（jiē）叹的！

text_en: And I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and all shall eat the flesh of their neighbors in the siege, and in the distress with which their enemies and those who seek their life afflict them.
text_cn: 我必使他们吞食自己子女的肉；在敌人和谋图他们性命的人围攻他们，处于困厄之时，必吞食自己近人的肉。

text_en: Then you shall break the jug in the sight of those who go with you,
text_cn: 以后，你就在与你同来的人眼前将那瓶打破，

text_en: and shall say to them: Thus says the Lord of hosts: So will I break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter’s vessel, so that it can never be mended. In Topheth they shall bury until there is no more room to bury.
text_cn: 对他们说：万军的上主这样说：我要这样破坏这人民和这城市，就如人打破这陶工的器皿，再也无法补救；人必将托斐特充作坟场，因为再没有地方可供埋葬。

text_en: Thus will I do to this place, says the Lord , and to its inhabitants, making this city like Topheth.
text_cn: 我必这样对待这地方和这地的居民──上主的断语──使这城市像托斐特一样；

text_en: And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah shall be defiled like the place of Topheth—all the houses upon whose roofs offerings have been made to the whole host of heaven, and libations have been poured out to other gods.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷的房屋和犹大王的宫殿，即他们在楼顶上向天上的万象献香，并给外方的神祇行奠礼的一切房屋，都必像托斐特一样，成为不洁的地方。”

text_en: When Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, he stood in the court of the Lord ’s house and said to all the people:
text_cn: 耶肋米亚奉上主派遣到托斐特宣讲预言回来以后，站在上主殿宇的庭院里，向全体人民说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I am now bringing upon this city and upon all its towns all the disaster that I have pronounced against it, because they have stiffened their necks, refusing to hear my words.
text_cn: “万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：看，我必给这城市和她所属的一切市镇，招来我对她说过的灾祸，因为她们硬着颈项，不肯听从我的话。”
